LanguageData.CC_Hyg_Adv_NoToilet_Detail: {0} colonist(s) have nowhere to go but out in the open, at a mood penalty each time. Even {1} would put a stop to it.
LanguageData.CC_Hyg_Adv_FewToilets_Detail: {0} colonists share {1} toilet(s). Someone is always waiting, and whoever can't wait goes outside. About one for every six keeps the line short; build {2} near the bedrooms.
LanguageData.CC_Hyg_Adv_NoWash_Detail: {0} colonist(s) have nowhere to get clean. Hygiene falls and mood with it, and bad hygiene raises the chance of food poisoning. Even {1} would do for now.
LanguageData.CC_Hyg_Adv_SickWater_Detail: {0} have dysentery, cholera or diarrhea. Dubs Bad Hygiene spreads them through dirty water and poor hygiene: look for a well near sewage, a latrine or a burn pit, or a contaminated water tower.
LanguageData.CC_Hyg_Reason_NoToilet: There's no latrine or toilet in the colony, so {PAWN_nameDef} has to go out in the open.
LanguageData.CC_Hyg_Reason_FewToilets: {COUNT} people share {HAVE} toilet(s), and {PAWN_nameDef} is tired of waiting.
LanguageData.CC_Hud_Trust_Tip: {0}'s trust in the council: {1}. Bitter at -45 or lower, devoted at 60 or higher.
